transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Thanks so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm in the right place, but... I guess the main thing that finally made me come in—and it's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly—is that my eating habits have just been kind of all over the place lately. 

I don't want to make a huge deal out of it, but it actually kind of scared me into making the appointment. Like, some days I'll just completely forget to eat my meals, which I know is really bad... and then other nights, I'm just tearing through takeout and snacks way past midnight. It's not usually like me to be so out of control with it. Does that make sense? I just wanted to get it checked out and make sure I'm doing the right thing.
Can you tell me more about the nights when you're eating a lot past midnight? Do you feel like you're eating much more rapidly than normal, or that you can't stop eating once you start?

Oh, um, no, I wouldn't say it's quite like that. I definitely don't want to make it sound like I'm just... stuffing my face out of nowhere, you know? I'm not eating super fast or anything like that. 

It's more just... I guess I realize I haven't really eaten all day, so I'll order some food and just kind of graze on it while I'm up. I definitely don't feel like I can't stop. I could stop whenever, I just... I guess I'm just catching up on calories because I forgot earlier? 

Is that a normal thing to do? I hope I'm explaining it right. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information, so I don't want to make it sound way worse or more dramatic than it actually is.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?

Well, um... I guess I wouldn't say I feel completely hopeless or anything. I don't want to sound like I'm just sitting around feeling sorry for myself, you know? But... I guess I have been a little less active lately. 

Normally, I'm a pretty busy guy. I used to play soccer on the weekends, and I really liked cooking dinners for my girlfriend, or even just checking out small art galleries around town. I'd even stick around at work to help the newer sales guys learn the ropes. But lately... I don't know, I just kind of can't make myself care about any of it right now. It's like the energy just isn't there, even though I know I should be doing those things. 

Does that sound like what you mean by losing interest? I hope I'm not making it sound like I'm just being lazy. I just want to make sure I'm answering your question the right way.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Um... well, no, not really. I mean, I definitely wouldn't say I'm depressed or feeling down most of the day. I try to keep a pretty positive attitude, you know? 

I guess I've just been feeling a little flat or tired, but I wouldn't call it sad. I still get up and go to work and everything. I don't want you to think I'm just miserable all the time or anything like that. It's more just... a lack of motivation, maybe? Is it okay if I describe it like that? I just really want to be accurate for you.
Have you noticed that activities you used to enjoy, like cooking for your girlfriend or playing soccer, don't bring you the same amount of pleasure lately?

Well, yeah, I guess that's a good way to put it. I don't want to sound like I'm complaining or anything, but... yeah, it's just like I was saying before. 

I used to really look forward to those things, you know? Like, the soccer games were a big part of my weekend, and cooking for my girlfriend was always fun. And the galleries, and helping the new guys at work... I used to get a lot out of that. But now, it's just... I don't know, it just feels like too much effort, and I don't really get that same good feeling from it anymore. I just can't seem to make myself care about doing any of it right now. 

I hope it's okay that I'm repeating myself a little bit. Does that make sense, what I'm trying to say? I just want to be sure I'm giving you what you need to know.
Have you noticed any change in your sleep patterns lately, like feeling rested with less sleep than usual?

Um, well... I wouldn't say I'm not sleeping at all or anything drastic like that. I don't want you to think I'm completely out of control with my sleep. But, um... I guess my sleep has been a little off lately. 

Most nights, I just kind of lie there because my mind keeps running through sales pitches for work, you know? Like, I just can't seem to shut it off. Or sometimes I'll wake up way before my alarm goes off, and I actually feel pretty wired and ready to go, even though I know I barely slept. 

I hope that doesn't sound too weird. Is it normal to feel like that when you're stressed at work? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of information.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like not feeling hungry as often or losing weight without trying?

Um, well... I really don't want you to think I'm completely letting myself go or anything. I usually try to take pretty good care of myself. But... honestly, that's kind of the main thing that scared me into actually coming in to see you. 

My eating has just been a little... all over the place lately. Like, some days I'll just completely forget to eat regular meals, I guess because I'm so focused on my sales calls or just distracted. But then other nights, I'll be up past midnight and I'm just tearing through takeout and whatever snacks I have lying around the kitchen. 

It's a little embarrassing to admit that, honestly. I hope you don't think too badly of me for it. Is that... is that normal when things get stressful? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right details so you can help.
Have you noticed that you've been feeling more fatigued or lacking in energy lately, even after a full night's sleep?

Um, well... I definitely don't want to sound lazy or anything. I usually pride myself on working really hard, especially with my clients. But, um... yeah, I guess I have been feeling a bit run down. 

Even on the nights when I do manage to lie down for a few hours, my body just feels completely drained the next day. Like, just carrying my sample cases into a client meeting feels like it takes way more out of me than it really should. It's frustrating because I want to be at my best for them. 

I hope it doesn't sound like I'm just making excuses for being tired. I just want to be honest with you so you get the full picture. Does that make sense?
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like playing soccer or cooking for your girlfriend, or is there still some interest, just not as much as before?

Um, well... I really don't want to sound like I'm just giving up on things or being a bad boyfriend. I usually try to be really active and involved, you know? But, um... I guess I'd have to say it's more like a complete loss of interest lately. 

I used to love playing soccer on the weekends, and I'd always cook nice dinners for my girlfriend. We'd even go check out small art galleries, and at work, I'd always try to help out the newer sales guys. But recently... I just can't seem to make myself care about any of it. It's like the drive to do those things is just gone. 

I feel terrible admitting that, especially about my girlfriend and the guys at work. I hope you don't think I'm just being selfish or lazy. Is it normal to just stop caring about things you usually love when you're feeling this way? I really hope I'm explaining this right for you.
Have you lost any weight recently without trying, or noticed that you've been eating less than usual even when you're not actively trying to lose weight?

Oh, um... I know I touched on this just a little bit ago, so I hope it's okay if I'm repeating myself. I definitely don't want to waste your time, I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need. 

But yeah, like I was saying earlier, my eating has just been completely all over the place lately. Honestly, it's kind of the main thing that scared me into finally coming in to see you. I'm definitely not trying to lose weight on purpose—I usually try to stay pretty on top of my health. It's just that some days I'll completely forget to eat my regular meals, and then other nights I'm up past midnight just tearing through takeout and whatever snacks I have around. 

I really try to keep a normal schedule, I promise I don't usually let things get this messy. Does that... does that answer what you were looking for, or did you need me to try and guess an exact number on the scale? I just want to be as helpful as possible.
Have you noticed that you've lost a significant amount of weight recently without trying to?

Um, yeah... I know I just mentioned this a second ago, so I hope I'm not being annoying by repeating it. I really don't want to sound like a broken record or anything. 

But, um, I haven't really weighed myself to know if I've lost a significant amount... it's more just that my eating is completely all over the place. Like I was saying, it's honestly the main thing that scared me into coming in today. I'll go from completely forgetting to eat meals during the day, to just tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight. 

I really try to take good care of myself usually, I promise. I don't want you to think I just let myself go. Does that help answer your question about the weight, or did you need me to try and figure out if my clothes are fitting differently? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed for the majority of the day, or is your mood more variable?

Um, well... I really hope this doesn't make me sound like I'm just sitting around feeling sorry for myself all day. I usually try to keep a really positive attitude, especially for my girlfriend and for the guys at work. I don't want to be a drag to be around, you know?

But, um... I guess if I'm being completely honest, most days lately I do feel pretty down for the majority of the day. It's just this heavy feeling that I can't seem to shake, even when I try my best to push through it and put on a brave face. I really try not to let it show, though. I hope that's the kind of answer you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm explaining my mood right for you.
How long have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Um... let's see. I guess it's been roughly four months? I really hope I don't sound like I'm just making excuses or complaining. I usually pride myself on being super reliable and upbeat. 

But yeah, this... this low mood, and I guess feeling guilty about things, and just sort of not caring about stuff I normally care about... it's been hanging around for about four months. I tried really hard to just ignore it and keep smiling, but it got a lot harder to do that after I had some trouble at work recently. I promise I'm usually much better at handling things, I don't want you to think I'm just a slacker or anything. 

Does that give you a good enough idea of the timeline, or did you need me to try and pinpoint an exact date for you? I want to make sure I'm answering this right.
Have you found it harder to focus, make decisions, or think clearly lately?

Um, I haven't really noticed any issues with that, honestly. I hope that's okay to say? I mean, I try really hard to stay sharp, especially for my job. In sales, you kind of have to be on your toes all the time, making quick decisions and keeping things moving. 

I really don't want to sound like I'm bragging or anything, but I usually pride myself on being pretty focused. I haven't felt like my thinking is cloudy or anything like that. I'm still able to handle my accounts and make the calls I need to make. 

Is that what you meant? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. If you need me to think harder about it, I definitely can.
Have you noticed that your movements have slowed down or that you feel restless and can't sit still more than usual?

Um, well... I really hope this doesn't make me sound too weird or like I'm all over the place. I try to keep it together, especially when I'm out seeing clients. 

But, um, I guess I have noticed a little bit of both? Like, when I'm at work, I'll catch myself pacing around my car before appointments, or I'm constantly tapping my hands on the steering wheel. I just feel kind of... revved up, I guess? But I try to hide it so I don't look unprofessional. 

Then, when I get home, it's like the opposite. I'll sit on the couch and it just feels like getting up to do anything takes forever. Like my body is just... heavy. I hope that makes sense? I know it sounds a little contradictory, but I want to make sure I'm giving you all the details you need. Is that the kind of thing you were asking about?

Have you experienced any of the following along with your low mood and loss of interest: significant changes in appetite or weight, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, feeling slowed down or restless, feeling worthless or guilty, or thoughts of death or suicide?

Um, well... I know I already mentioned the guilt and the restless stuff, and I really don't want to sound like I'm just falling apart completely. I try to keep a good routine, I really do. 

But, um, I guess my eating has been a little... inconsistent lately? Honestly, it's kind of what scared me into finally making this appointment. I hope you don't judge me for this, but my appetite has just been all over the place. Like, some days I'm so busy or just... out of it, that I completely forget to eat meals. And then other nights, I'll be up past midnight just tearing through takeout and whatever snacks I can find. 

I know it's not a healthy way to live, and I'm really trying to do better with it. I promise I'm usually much more disciplined. I haven't really noticed any thoughts about death or anything extreme like that, though. I hope I'm answering this okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture without sounding like a total mess.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living or had thoughts about not wanting to live anymore?

Um, I know I literally just said I didn't have thoughts about death, and I really hope you aren't upset with me for backtracking. I just... I want to make sure I'm doing this right and being completely honest with you, even if it's a little embarrassing to admit. 

It's definitely not that I want to, you know, end things. I haven't made any sort of plan to hurt myself, I promise. I would never do that. It's more just... sometimes, when I'm feeling really low and heavy, I've had these passing thoughts where I kind of wish I could just... not wake up for a little while? Like, just hit pause on everything and sleep through the hard parts. 

But I really don't want you to worry about me, or think I'm a danger to myself. I'm usually a very positive guy, I really am. Is it okay to feel like that sometimes? I just hope I'm not sounding too crazy or making things seem worse than they are.
